name: 实现 DeploymentService
description:
实现 DeploymentService 服务方法: executeDeployment, getDeploymentStatus, cancelDeployment
  - executeDeployment: (request: DeploymentRequest, user: User) -> DeploymentResponse pre=DeploymentRequest 包含有效的目标环境ID和文件信息，且用户已认证
  - getDeploymentStatus: (deploymentId: str) -> DeploymentJob pre=deploymentId 存在且用户有权访问
  - cancelDeployment: (deploymentId: str) -> bool pre=deploymentId 存在且用户有权操作，部署尚未完成
